module_signature.description: Serial load enable; shift din MSB-first each rising edge
module_signature.name: load_en

module_signature.description: Serial data in: 80-bit key then 64-bit plaintext, MSB first
module_signature.name: din

module_signature.description: Serial unload enable; shift ciphertext out when done is high
module_signature.name: shift_out_en

module_signature.description: Serial ciphertext out, MSB first (ciphertext[63] first)
module_signature.name: dout

module_signature.description: Asserted when ciphertext is valid; held until reset or new load
module_signature.name: done

Implement PRESENT-80 block cipher reference model with serial load/unload interface
FSM states: IDLE, LOAD, ENCRYPT, DONE
Load phase: 144 cycles MSB-first into {key_reg[79:0], state[63:0]}
Encrypt phase: 31 full rounds + 1 final addRoundKey = 32 cycles total
Key schedule: 61-bit left rotate, S-box on top 4 bits, XOR round counter into bits [19:15]
Unload: MSB-first serial output of state[63:0] when done and shift_out_en
